rules.accepted_credit_types: Technician-specific ACPE or board-approved CPE (1 unit = 10 credit hours), earned in the 12 months before expiration
rules.new_licensee_rule: Waived at first renewal for technicians certified between July 1 of the previous year and June 30 of the current year (not for reinstatement).
rules.alternatives: Military technicians (CPT-M) are waived from CPE.
rules.audit_note: Renewal runs an automated CPE Monitor check; certificate expires if CE is not on file.
rules.notes: Louisiana issues pharmacy technician certificates, renewed annually May 1-June 30. CPE must be recorded in NABP CPE Monitor.
rules.legal_basis: La. Admin. Code tit. 46, pt. LIII, §909
